subtitle: Ride the Moon-Current
shortDescription: Steer Glowfin through a living underwater kingdom and master each current.
promotionalText: One-finger steering, recoverable collisions, Daily Tide trials, saved ghosts and cosmetic-only progression in a luminous underwater world.
fullDescription:
Glowfin is a one-finger underwater current-running game. Drag left or right while Glowfin swims forward automatically. Follow wide cyan routes for safety, take a narrow Moonflash route when you want more risk and reward, and recover after a collision instead of losing the run immediately.

Learn through a short guided tutorial, earn Lumen Pearls, raise your Tide Level, and collect cosmetic colours, fins, trails and auras that never change competitive performance. Return for a deterministic Daily Tide, race your saved same-seed ghost, or open a verified Beat My Current challenge shared from Glowfin's authenticated playable site.

Glowfin contains no chat, real-money purchase, loot box or live advertising SDK in Version 39. Telemetry is off until the player explicitly opts in, and accessibility settings include reduced motion, high contrast and reduced-travel steering.
